contentMap.productCategory: AI Image Generation and AI Video Generation
contentMap.targetAudience: Professionals creating high-quality visual content, including creative directors, video producers, and art directors

hero.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
hero.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 (Image Generation) and Seedance 1.5 Pro (Video Generation) - advanced foundation models developed by ByteDance for high-quality visual content creation.
hero.supportingLine: From text prompts, images, or scripts, generate professional visuals and videos with powerful multimodal AI systems.

productSections.name: Seedream 4.5
productSections.label: Feature 1
productSections.headline: AI Image Generation with Seedream 4.5
productSections.description:
Seedream 4.5 is a high-performance multimodal image generation system designed to produce high-resolution, high-fidelity images from text prompts and visual inputs.
The model unifies text-to-image synthesis, image editing, and multi-image composition within a single framework.

features.title: Advanced Capabilities of Seedream 4.5 by ByteDance
features.description: From accurate text rendering to consistent image editing and multi-image composition, Seedream 4.5 powers high-quality, professional visual creation with superior precision and control.

features.title: Advanced Text–Image Alignment
features.description: Accurately translates prompts into visuals with improved semantic understanding.

features.title: High-Resolution Output
features.description: Generate native images up to 1K–4K resolution with strong visual fidelity.

features.title: Superior Typographic Rendering
features.description: Optimized for posters, ads, and text-heavy visual designs.

features.title: Multi-Image Composition with Identity Preservation
features.description: Combines multiple inputs while accurately maintaining subject consistency.

features.title: Strong Structural Fidelity
features.description: Maintains composition, layout, and scene structure with high precision.

productSections.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro
productSections.label: Additional Feature:-
productSections.headline: AI Video Generation with Seedance 1.5 Pro by Bytedance
productSections.description:
Seedance 1.5 Pro is a next-generation generative model designed for native audio-visual generation, enabling synchronized creation of video and sound together.
Built on a dual-branch diffusion transformer architecture, the model integrates cross-modal learning to produce coherent visual and audio outputs.

features.title: Key Capabilities of Seedance 1.5 Pro
features.description: Seedance enables professional-grade AI video production with narrative coherence and realistic motion.

features.title: Text-to-Video Generation
features.description: Create videos directly from text prompts.

features.title: Audio-Visual Synchronization
features.description: Generate video and audio simultaneously with strong multimodal alignment.

features.title: Multilingual Lip-Sync
features.description: Supports multilingual and dialect-level lip synchronization.

features.title: Cinematic Camera Control
features.description: Generate videos with dynamic camera movement and cinematic storytelling.

features.title: 10× Faster Inference
features.description: Optimized inference pipeline significantly improves generation speed.

plans.name: Seedream 4.5 (AI Image Generation)
includes: Enhanced typographic rendering for posters, ads & text-heavy designs

plans.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro (AI Video Generation)
includes: Fast inference for quicker video production

testimonials.quote: Seedream allows us to generate high-resolution creative visuals from simple prompts. It has dramatically reduced our design turnaround time.
testimonials.author: Vaishali Saxena

testimonials.quote: Seedance’s ability to generate synchronized audio and video is incredibly powerful for storytelling and branded content.
testimonials.author: Vihaan Pandey

testimonials.quote: The multimodal editing capabilities in Seedream make it easy to refine images with precision.
testimonials.author: Anurag Malhotra

designNotes: Prioritize a conversion-first layout with a strong hero and immediate form entry point.
Keep typography large and legible, with short supporting copy and scannable bullets.
Use a simple stacked structure and avoid competing interactive patterns unless future sections introduce them.
Maintain clear section boundaries and generous padding to preserve readability.
If extending this page, preserve the minimal-interaction, high-intent lead-capture approach rather than adding heavy visual complexity.

personality.buyer: Creative directors, video producers, art directors, and enterprise content teams creating premium visual assets at scale
personality.reasoning: This product is about high-end AI image and video generation, so the visual language should feel inventive but exacting: premium enough for creative professionals, technically credible enough for enterprise buyers, and dynamic enough to reflect multimodal generation. The brand palette is locked to Techjockey colors, so the identity should be built from orange, black, white, and soft grey — using orange as the energetic engine rather than a generic sci-fi gradient. The overall feel should combine editorial clarity with cinematic depth, using split panels, layered product shells, floating prompt chips, and strong contrast between image and video sections to make the page feel intelligent and interactive.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The headline is long and needs to stay elegant and readable without feeling cramped. 48px preserves impact while allowing a premium two-line composition.

colours.colourReason: The brand’s existing orange becomes the primary hero color and CTA color exactly as required. Black and white anchor the premium enterprise feel, while soft grey is used for separation and card surfaces. No outside palette is introduced, keeping the identity strictly tied to Techjockey.

backgroundSystem.hero: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff6b00 0%, #1a1a1a 100%) with subtle mesh texture and layered abstract waveform overlays

layout.heroBackground: Deep orange-led cinematic hero with a dark overlay panel and bright white typography for strong contrast
layout.heroReason: The product has strong visual output, so the hero should immediately show a generated visual mockup or layered AI canvas on the right while the left side carries the message. This gives the page premium energy and communicates capability instantly.
layout.featureReason: There are two distinct products: Seedream 4.5 for image generation and Seedance 1.5 Pro for video generation. Alternating sections creates clear separation and stronger contrast while letting each model get its own spotlight treatment.
layout.darkSectionFor: Hero and the Seedance 1.5 Pro section to reflect cinematic motion and audio-visual generation

personality.imageryDirection: Use high-contrast JPEG hero imagery showing a polished AI creative workstation, layered prompt-to-output visuals, and cinematic preview frames. For product sections, use PNG UI shells or mock generation canvases with floating prompt chips, output thumbnails, timeline strips, audio waveforms, and comparison panels. Logos and icons should be clean SVG line icons. Add CSS-built visual richness where screenshots are missing: blurred glow edges, layered cards, typography samples, motion frames, and composition grids.
personality.designPersonality: Premium creative intelligence: editorial clarity meets cinematic AI. It should feel like a high-end generative studio for professionals — controlled, modern, visually expressive, and enterprise-trustworthy, with orange as the signature pulse throughout.

designIntent.audience: Professionals creating high-quality visual content, including creative directors, video producers, and art directors
designIntent.primaryUserIntent: Evaluate whether Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro can deliver professional-grade AI image and video generation with enough quality, control, and speed to justify a sales inquiry or demo request

brandDirection.tone: Expert, confident, and outcomes-led with a B2B polish; technical credibility should feel clear without becoming overly dense or academic
brandDirection.visualStyle: Premium enterprise software landing page with a strong, dark or deep brand-colour hero, clean stacked sections, structured feature cards, and restrained visual complexity

sectionPurpose.purpose: Establish the value proposition immediately: professional AI image and video generation from ByteDance models, with a clear primary action to generate with AI
Explain image-generation capability, precision, fidelity, editing, and composition benefits for creative workflows
Explain video-generation capability, audio-video synchronization, multilingual lip-sync, and cinematic control for production teams
Provide commercial anchoring and a quote-based buying path for both models, with pricing clarity where available
Add peer validation from creative roles to reduce hesitation and reinforce relevance for professional users

Translate the extras into 3-4 concise proof points if needed: AI image generation, AI video generation with audio, multimodal content creation, enterprise-ready infrastructure.

Use only the valid testimonials and omit the malformed final quote. Make the cards role-specific and credible: Creative Director, Video Producer, Art Director. Keep star rating only if the page system requires it; otherwise maintain a simple quote-led layout consistent with input.

layoutStrategy.hero: Use a strong full-width hero with a dark or deep brand-coloured background, left-aligned copy, and a single primary CTA. Because no product screenshot is provided, prioritize typography, spacing, and value bullets over imagery. Keep the above-the-fold hierarchy extremely clear.
layoutStrategy.features: Use two stacked, product-specific sections with strong internal structure: headline, descriptive paragraph, then feature cards. Each section should be visually separated but stylistically consistent, with clean white cards on a light background to improve readability after the hero.
layoutStrategy.proof: Use testimonials as social validation for creative roles, keeping the layout compact and readable. This section should feel credible and human rather than promotional.
layoutStrategy.pricing: Use a centered, comparison-friendly pricing block that makes quote-based buying feel straightforward. Maintain a clean hierarchy between the image model and the video model, with one plan containing explicit starting price and the other framed as request-for-quote.
layoutStrategy.form: No form section should be designed because includeForm is false. Use CTAs as outbound conversion actions only, primarily Generate with AI and Get Quote.

Follow with pricing and testimonials for commercial reassurance. Keep the interface premium, structured, and trustworthy, with minimal motion, strong hierarchy, and no form module.
